A JoJo-inspired **The World Stand Controller** with target following, blocking, vanish/summon, barrage, animations, sounds, and a **DIO / The World-themed GUI**.

### 🎮 How to Use

1. Execute the script.
2. Enter the **target player's name** in the Target Name box.
3. Press **The World: OFF** to activate The World.
4. The World will automatically follow the selected player.

### 💬 Chat Commands

Type these commands in chat:

* `SUMMON` — Summons/activates The World.
* `VANISH` — Sends your character high into the sky while your camera follows the target.
* `SUMMON` — Returns your character to its original position after using `VANISH`.
* `BARRAGE` — Performs the **MUDA MUDA!** barrage attack.
* `BLOCK` — Moves The World in front of the target.
* `UNBLOCK` — Stops blocking.

### 👊 MUDA MUDA! Barrage

Use the **「 MUDA MUDA! 」** button in the GUI to perform the attack.

Includes:

* Punch animation
* **MUDA! MUDA! MUDA!** voice line
* Punch sound effects
* Fling effect
* Temporary color effect

### ⚙️ GUI Settings

* **Position** — Controls how far behind the target The World stays.
* **Offset** — Moves The World left/right.
* **Float Height** — Controls The World's height.
* **GUI** — Hides/shows the controller.
* The GUI can be **dragged around the screen**.

### 🕴️ The World Animations

The World automatically switches between an idle levitation animation and a movement animation depending on whether the target is moving.

### 🔧 Extra

Press **N** to toggle the included noclip feature — useful for getting through places with thick walls.

local function SendChatMessage(message)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local textChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if textChannel then
            textChannel:SendAsync(message)
        end
    else
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(message, "All")
    end
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local difference = hrp.Position - targetHRP.Position

                if difference.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local vec = difference.Unit
                    local dot = math.clamp(targetLook:Dot(vec), -1, 1)
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(dot))

                    if angle <= maxAngle then
                        local dist = difference.Magnitude

                        if dist < closestDist then
                            closestDist = dist
                            closest = hrp
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

do
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput = nil
    local dragStart = nil
    local startPosition = nil

    local function updateDrag(input)
        if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPosition then
            return
        end

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then
            return
        end

        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

        local newX = startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local newY = startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

        newX = math.clamp(
            newX,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
        )

        newY = math.clamp(
            newY,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        )

        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
    end

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            local target = input.Target

            if target == closeBtn
                or target == guiToggle
                or target == targetBox
                or target == standBtn
                or target == punchBtn
                or target == posBox
                or target == offBox
                or target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    dragInput = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput then
            updateDrag(input)
        end
    end)
end

        if p ~= player and p.Name:lower():find(namePart) then

end

local function enableStand()
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

    if not bp then
        bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition")

        bp.P = 2000
        bp.D = 50
        bp.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
        bp.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end

    if not gyro then
        gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        gyro.P = 2000
        gyro.D = 50
        gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        gyro.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        gyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end
end

local function disableStand()
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = true
        end
    end

    if bp then
        bp:Destroy()
        bp = nil
    end

    if gyro then
        gyro:Destroy()
        gyro = nil
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if standOn and bp and gyro and targetBox.Text ~= "" then

        if vanished and savedCharacterCFrame then
            bp.Position = Vector3.new(
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.Z
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                bp.Position,
                bp.Position + savedCharacterCFrame.LookVector
            )

            return
        end

        floatTime += dt * 2
        local floatOffset = math.sin(floatTime) * 0.5

        local t = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetHRP = t.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local tcf = targetHRP.CFrame
            local desiredPos

            if blocking then
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    + tcf.LookVector * BLOCK_DISTANCE
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
            else
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    - tcf.LookVector * standDistance
                    + tcf.RightVector * sideOffset
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset + floatOffset, 0)
            end

            bp.Position = bp.Position:Lerp(
                desiredPos,
                math.clamp(followSpeed, 0.01, 1)
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + tcf.LookVector

        end
    end
end)

        return

    if lowerMessage:find("summon") then

	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keys.W = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keys.A = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keys.S = true end

-- Dragging
-- The decorative Star Platinum and menacing images are children of mainFrame,
-- so they automatically move with the controller.
do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart = Vector2.new()
    local startPos = mainFrame.Position

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            -- Don't drag when clicking controls or decorative images.
            if input.Target == closeBtn
                or input.Target == guiToggle
                or input.Target == targetBox
                or input.Target == standBtn
                or input.Target == punchBtn
                or input.Target == posBox
                or input.Target == offBox
                or input.Target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if dragging then
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local delta = mousePos - dragStart

            local newX = math.clamp(
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X - mainFrame.Size.X.Offset
            )

            local newY = math.clamp(
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y - mainFrame.Size.Y.Offset
            )

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, newX, 0, newY)
        end
    end)
end

local function runPastebinStyleFling(duration)
    local start = tick()
    local movel = 0.1

    while tick() - start < duration do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000
                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel
                + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

local function onPlayerChatted(otherPlayer, message)
    local targetName = targetBox.Text

    if not targetName or targetName == "" then
        return
    end

    local lowerMessage = message:lower()

    local targetMatches =
        otherPlayer.Name:lower():find(targetName:lower())

    if not targetMatches then
        return
    end

    if standOn and lowerMessage:find("barrage") then
        punchTarget()
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("block")
        and standOn
        and not vanished
        and not blocking then

        blocking = true
        SendChatMessage("BLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("unblock")
        and standOn
        and blocking then

        blocking = false
        SendChatMessage("UNBLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("vanish")
        and standOn
        and not vanished then

        vanished = true

        savedCharacterCFrame =
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject

        humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
            )

        local target =
            findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if target and target.Character then
            local targetHumanoid =
                target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if targetHumanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid
            end
        end

        SendChatMessage("Yare Yare Daze")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("summon") then

        if blocking then
            blocking = false
        end

        if vanished then
            vanished = false

            if savedCharacterCFrame
                and humanoidRootPart
                and humanoidRootPart.Parent then

                humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
                    savedCharacterCFrame
            end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if humanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
            elseif savedCameraSubject then
                camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            end

            savedCharacterCFrame = nil
            savedCameraSubject = nil

            SendChatMessage("Star Platinum, Toki wo Tomare")
            return
        end

        standOn = not standOn

        standBtn.Text =
            standOn
            and "「 STAND: ON 」"
            or "「 STAND: OFF 」"

        if standOn then
            enableStand()

            local t =
                findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

            if t
                and t.Character
                and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

                for _, id in ipairs(summonSoundIds) do
                    local summon =
                        Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)

                    summon.SoundId = id
                    summon.Volume = 1
                    summon:Play()

                    Debris:AddItem(summon, 3)
                end
            end

            SendChatMessage("Star Platinum, Toki wo Tomare")
        else
            disableStand()
        end
    end
end

scripts.script:
local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local jb = 14

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local joint = root:WaitForChild("RootJoint")
	local c0 = joint.C0
	local on = false

	local function stop()
		if on then
			rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("backflip")
			on = false
		end
		if joint.Parent then
			joint.C0 = c0
		end
	end

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
		if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
			if on then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end
		if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		stop()
		on = true
		local md0 = hum.MoveDirection
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local dir
		if md0.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			dir = -Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		else
			local f = md0:Dot(look)
			local r = md0:Dot(right)
			if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then
				dir = f > 0 and look or -look
			else
				dir = r > 0 and right or -right
			end
		end
		local axis = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis:Cross(dir)).Unit
		local g = workspace.Gravity
		local v = (hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight)) + jb
		local dur = math.max(2 * v / g * 0.95, 0.35)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local boosted = false
		rs:BindToRenderStep("backflip", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			if a >= 1 or hum.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
				stop()
				return
			end
			if not boosted then
				boosted = true
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, jb, 0)
			end
			joint.C0 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, a * math.pi * 2) * c0
		end)
	end)
end

if plr.Character then
	task.spawn(setup, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)

-- Educational UI Concept for Reset-Safe State Persistence
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create a ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "PersistentFlightGui"
-- CRUCIAL: Stops Roblox from deleting this UI when you die
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false 
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Main Container Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
MainFrame.Active = true 
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- ==========================================
-- MOBILE FINGER & MOUSE DRAGGING ENGINE
-- ==========================================
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, 
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
        startPos.Y.Scale, 
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)
-- ==========================================

-- Minimize / Maximize Toggle Button
local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 25)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
MinBtn.Text = "-"
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 30, 30)
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- Flight Toggle Button
local FlightButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlightButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 30)
FlightButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
FlightButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlightButton.Parent = MainFrame

-- Directional Controls Frame
local ControlFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 150)
ControlFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
ControlFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ControlFrame.Visible = false
ControlFrame.Parent = MainFrame

-- Helper function to build uniform directional buttons
local function createButton(name, pos, text)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Parent = ControlFrame
    return btn
end

-- Layout direction elements
local UpBtn    = createButton("UpBtn",    UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 5),   "Up")
local LeftBtn  = createButton("LeftBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 50),  "Left")
local RightBtn = createButton("RightBtn", UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50), "Right")
local DownBtn  = createButton("DownBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 95),  "Down")

-- Global States & Physics Trackers
local flightActive = false
local isMinimized = false
local movementVelocity = nil
local rotationGyro = nil
local MOVEMENT_SPEED = 2 

-- References to the active character (changes when you die)
local currentCharacter = nil
local currentHumanoid = nil
local currentRootPart = nil

-- Core function to enable or disable physics setups
local function updatePhysicsState()
    if not currentCharacter or not currentHumanoid or not currentRootPart then return end
    
    -- Clean up any lingering objects from a previous character life
    if movementVelocity then movementVelocity:Destroy() movementVelocity = nil end
    if rotationGyro then rotationGyro:Destroy() rotationGyro = nil end
    
    if flightActive then
        FlightButton.Text = "DISABLE"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
        if not isMinimized then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = MOVEMENT_SPEED
        
        -- Orient character flat immediately
        local flatTargetCFrame = currentRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        currentRootPart.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame
        
        -- Apply locking forces
        rotationGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        rotationGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5) 
        rotationGyro.D = 100 
        rotationGyro.P = 10000 
        rotationGyro.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame 
        rotationGyro.Parent = currentRootPart
        
        movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        movementVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6) 
        movementVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) 
        movementVelocity.Parent = currentRootPart
    else
        FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        currentRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRootPart.Position)
    end
end

-- Hook up Character Re-binding loops (Fires every time you respawn)
local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
    currentCharacter = newCharacter
    currentHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    currentRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Instantly enforce the flight/flat physics if it was left ON when you died
    updatePhysicsState()
end

-- Connect to existing character, and listen for future spawns
if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

-- Minimize/Maximize UI Logic
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 40)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        MinBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
        if flightActive then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        MinBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Manual UI Toggle Button Press Listener
FlightButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    flightActive = not flightActive
    updatePhysicsState()
end)

-- Velocity Controller Direction mapping
local function applyPhysicsVelocity(directionVector)
    if not flightActive or not movementVelocity then return end
    movementVelocity.Velocity = directionVector * MOVEMENT_SPEED
end

-- Button click/tap bindings
UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

LeftBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) end)
LeftBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

RightBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)) end)
RightBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)
